subject: Decision Making
title: Dark Defaults
description: A micro-lesson that makes Dark Defaults usable.

hook.text: Ryanair pre-selects travel insurance during checkout. Most travelers never notice.

buildup.text: Dark defaults are pre-selected options that benefit the company, not the customer.

discovery.text: Pre-checked donation boxes, auto-added warranties, and default data sharing all use the same mechanism.

twist.text: GDPR banned pre-checked consent boxes in Europe. The law recognized that defaults are not genuine choices.

climax.text: Dark defaults blur the line between nudge and manipulation. The same tool that saves lives with organ donation steals.

punchline.text: Same tool, different intent. Dark defaults exploit your inertia for profit.

quiz.question: What are dark defaults?
options: Pre-selected options designed to benefit the company at the customer's expense
